notes:
v0.11.0 Update
- GlitchSmith Actor sheet controls now appear under one GlitchSmith dropdown.
- The unified menu is enabled by default and can be disabled per client in GlitchSmith Library settings.
- Legacy and Application V2 Actor sheets are supported on Foundry V13 and V14.

announcement.title: 🔔 GlitchSmith Library v0.11.0
announcement.content:
GlitchSmith Library v0.11.0 can group GlitchSmith controls on Actor sheets.

  • Wallet, Cinematic FX, HUD Overlay URL, VN Portrait Config, Shop Settings, and Relationship Tracker controls appear under one GlitchSmith dropdown when available.
  • The option is enabled by default and can be turned off separately by each user.
  • The original visibility checks, permissions, and actions remain in effect.
